triggers.name: on_auth_user_created
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin

    insert into public.profiles (
        id,
        username,
        role
    )
    values (
        new.id,
        coalesce(
            new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'username',
            'Investigator'
        ),
        'user'
    );

    return new;

end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1
        from public.profiles
        where id = auth.uid()
        and role = 'admin'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_review_creature(p_creature_id bigint, p_status text, p_verified_threat_level text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin

    if not public.is_admin() then
        raise exception 'ADMIN_REQUIRED';
    end if;


    if p_status not in (
        'verified',
        'investigation',
        'conflicting',
        'canon'
    ) then
        raise exception 'INVALID_STATUS';
    end if;


    if p_verified_threat_level is not null
       and p_verified_threat_level not in (
            'F',
            'E',
            'D',
            'C',
            'B',
            'A',
            'S',
            'SS',
            'X'
       ) then
        raise exception 'INVALID_THREAT_LEVEL';
    end if;


    update public.creatures
    set
        status = p_status,

        verified_threat_level =
            case

                when p_status in (
                    'verified',
                    'canon'
                )
                then p_verified_threat_level

                else null

            end,

        updated_at = now()

    where id = p_creature_id;


    if not found then
        raise exception 'CREATURE_NOT_FOUND';
    end if;

end;
$function$

constraints.name: creatures_creator_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (creator_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: creature_abilities_creature_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (creature_id) REFERENCES creatures(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
